scope: 201 search results retrieved, including multiface spillover; twelve named alternatives given explicit fit assessment. Not an exhaustive competitive usage audit or gameplay test.

records.name: Erode
records.assessment: One-mana instant creature/planeswalker answer independent of our board. Ramps opponent with basic replacement; do not treat as free early tempo or exile.

source_record.name: Erode
source_record.oracle_text: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
source_record.flavor_text:
"Our lives are built upon our pasts. What happens, then, if we are cut off from them?"
—Augusta, dean of order

records.name: Restoration Magic
records.assessment: One-mana targeted permanent hexproof/indestructible protects creature or Smile. Five total mana for team mode; not cheap sweeper protection. Does not solve nontargeted exile/sacrifice/-toughness.

source_record.name: Restoration Magic
source_record.oracle_text:
Tiered (Choose one additional cost.)
• Cure — {0} — Target permanent gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
• Cura — {1} — Target permanent gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. You gain 3 life.
• Curaga — {3}{W} — Permanents you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. You gain 6 life.

records.name: Sheltered by Ghosts
records.assessment: Two-mana broad nonland exile plus lifelink/ward. Aggressive synergy and artifact coverage; creature-dependent, vulnerable to removal in response and removal of carrier later.

source_record.name: Sheltered by Ghosts
source_record.oracle_text:
Enchant creature you control
When this Aura enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this Aura leaves the battlefield.
Enchanted creature gets +1/+0 and has lifelink and ward {2}.

records.name: Get Lost
records.assessment: Independent instant creature/enchantment/planeswalker removal. Maps are material opponent value; no artifact mode unless artifact also creature.

source_record.name: Get Lost
source_record.oracle_text: Destroy target creature, enchantment, or planeswalker. Its controller creates two Map tokens. (They're artifacts with "{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Target creature you control explores. Activate only as a sorcery.")

records.name: Seam Rip
records.assessment: One-mana exile alternative without ramp, but MV ceiling misses expensive blockers and engines; temporary exile vulnerable to removal.

source_record.name: Seam Rip
source_record.oracle_text: When this enchantment enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value 2 or less until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
source_record.flavor_text: Drix hunt down Eldrazi Potentiate without hesitation or explanation.

records.name: Dawn's Truce
records.assessment: Two-mana team hexproof and, with card gift, indestructible. Better cheap anti-destroy-sweeper protection than Restoration; would need a slot-preserving reassignment of protection/removal across bands.

source_record.name: Dawn's Truce
source_record.oracle_text:
Gift a card (You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they draw a card before its other effects.)
You and permanents you control gain hexproof until end of turn. If the gift was promised, permanents you control also gain indestructible until end of turn.

records.name: Boros Charm
records.assessment: Two-mana team indestructible plus damage or double strike; RW color demand and no targeted exile protection. Not unconditional creature removal.

source_record.name: Boros Charm
source_record.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Boros Charm deals 4 damage to target player or planeswalker.
• Permanents you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
• Target creature gains double strike until end of turn.

records.name: Lightning Helix
records.assessment: Two-mana burn/lifegain/reach option. RW cost and three damage ceiling; compare against broad answers rather than assume reach required.

source_record.name: Lightning Helix
source_record.oracle_text: Lightning Helix deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
source_record.flavor_text: After heavy casualties in the Phyrexian invasion, the Boros mage-priests trained as many rank-and-file soldiers as possible to wield the Legion's legendary battle magic.

records.name: Saved by the Shell
records.assessment: Two printed mana protection/trample/counter package; discount with Michelangelo only when Turtle controlled. Cannot silently put this in printed one-mana band.

source_record.name: Saved by the Shell
source_record.oracle_text:
This spell costs {1} less to cast if you control a Turtle.
Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains trample, hexproof, and indestructible until end of turn.

records.name: Exorcise
records.assessment: Permanent sorcery-speed artifact/enchantment/large-creature exile; cannot hit low-power small engine creatures and cannot respond at instant speed.

source_record.name: Exorcise
source_record.oracle_text: Exile target artifact, enchantment, or creature with power 4 or greater.
source_record.flavor_text:
"Strictly speaking, you can't kill what's already dead, but trapping and disintegrating it is pretty close."
—Garden, survivor technologist

records.name: Impractical Joke
records.assessment: One-mana sorcery three-damage creature/planeswalker removal; no ramp but toughness cap and no face mode.

source_record.name: Impractical Joke
source_record.oracle_text: Damage can't be prevented this turn. Impractical Joke deals 3 damage to up to one target creature or planeswalker.
source_record.flavor_text: Strixhaven students have a sense of humor. The spirits of the Blood Age do not.

records.name: Defend the Rider
records.assessment: One-mana permanent hexproof/indestructible with independent Pilot mode. Green flexibility and boardless floor; Restoration chosen for white interaction consolidation and optional five-mana team mode, not universal superiority.

source_record.name: Defend the Rider
source_record.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Target permanent you control gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
• Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."
